utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure I can be much help with the repair drive, Oren. I've got some things on my mind.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive... was it something with your fence? I think I remember now—the storm knocked it down, didn't it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the fence is still down. I just haven't had the energy to deal with it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, can you check if Oren's toolbox has a socket set? That's what I need for my mower.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm not sure about Oren's toolbox, but by the way, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Sunday works. But I still need that socket set—can you check Oren's toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, yeah, I think I can pitch in this weekend—just tell me where to go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh great, Bo! We're planning for Saturday morning at the school parking lot, does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning works for me. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You know, Cleo, I've been volunteering my tools for that drive. Got a whole crate ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Gus, that's wonderful! We've been getting some good donations, and your crate will really help us cover more repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Cleo. Just let me know if you need any specific tools I should add to the crate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I like a set schedule. Saturday morning works best for me—makes for a tidy start. What time exactly are we kicking things off?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Eli, I'm sorry—I should've mentioned it sooner. The drive was moved to Sunday at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? Hmm, that's a change. I guess I can rearrange my schedule. What time on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, they even fixed that old tractor down on Elm Street—imagine what they could do with that toaster of yours, Pia!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that is impressive, Tess! But just a heads-up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at my porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Pia! Sunday at the community center—got it, I'll spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! We're meeting at my garage at 9 AM on Saturday. I'll send you the address.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I'll have my tools ready. Could you send me the garage address so I can map it out?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing! It's 123 Maple Street — just look for the blue garage with all the folks gathering.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Hana! The repair drive... I think it's this Saturday? Or maybe it already happened? I'm so lost.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Saturday? I thought it was next weekend. Let me double-check the flyer before we mix up the dates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, next weekend? That sounds right too. I swear I saw it written somewhere, but I lost the paper.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sam, are you also thinking of joining the repair drive? I've got a few things I could use a hand with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rey! I was just about to see if anyone needed help. What do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uh, there's this old creaky door hinge in the back that's been driving me crazy. You any good with that sort of thing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, did you hear? We're planning a neighborhood repair drive this weekend to fix up the community garden tools — it's going to be great!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it! Sounds like a solid plan — just count me in a bit late, you know how I roll.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, absolutely, no worries! We're starting Saturday morning, so just swing by whenever you can — it's going to be a fun time fixing things up together!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, brilliant—my hedge trimmer's been on the fritz for weeks. Count me in with spare parts and a stubborn attitude!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll let the fixers know you're coming! Maybe they can take a look at my toaster too while they're at it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A toaster and a hedge trimmer? We'll have half the neighborhood's appliances sorted by lunch!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that's what I've been hearing too—a few leaks up there, nothing major yet, but they want to get ahead of it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are they planning to patch it up or replace the whole roof?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think they're leaning towards patching it for now, but who knows—might change if they find more damage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I think it's a great chance to fix up that old stuff we've got lying around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're serious about this repair drive? Like, actually happening? I'll believe it when I see a flyer or something official.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh it's official alright! I've seen the sign-up sheet at the community center and everything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could help out if you need an extra hand, and I have some basic tools too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, great! But heads-up, the drive's now Sunday at the community center—could you still make it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday works for me. What kind of tools should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: So Bo, what do you need me to bring for the repair drive? I've got a good set of wrenches and some spare handles.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, wrenches sound good—just bring 'em along. I gotta run, but Tess mentioned they fixed a tractor, so it's probably gonna be useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I'll grab my wrenches then. See you at the drive!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, have you heard anything more about that repair drive? I keep getting mixed messages about when it is.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's still on for Saturday morning, Nell. I'm just waiting for a few more tool donations to come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know it's still on Saturday. What tools are you still waiting for?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm getting everyone together to help out!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, I think I remember... wait, what exactly are we fixing again? I might've left my list somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's for all the little things around the neighborhood that need mending — cracked fences, loose railings, that old bench in the park. I'm counting on your handyman skills!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Faye! The repair drive is this Saturday, but I'm not sure of the exact start time. I saw the truck over on Elm Street earlier, so they're already getting started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh great, so it's definitely this Saturday then. Let me check with the school office for the official start time and I'll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye! I did see the truck on Elm Street near the old oak, so maybe they're starting from that end.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds good, I might be a bit late though—you know how I am.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, sure, no worries. I can't even remember when it is, so being late is totally fine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ha, at least I'm not the only one who loses track of time. We'll figure it out when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard it's this Saturday... for the garden tools. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, Eli was asking about the start time—I think we're kicking off around 10 on Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I'll mark my calendar. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, you thinking of joining the repair drive too? I've got my toolbox ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You bet, Gus! I’ve got that wobbly chair I’ve been dying to get fixed — any chance you can take a look?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Ira! Bring it by the drive and I'll tighten it up for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, I'll bring it Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, Leo, the drive was moved to Sunday at the community center, so bring your mower then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday works. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm glad we're doing this. So, what time exactly should I be there Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think it starts at 9am, but if you're like me, you'll want to get there by 8:30 to grab a good spot—coffee's on too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 8:30 sounds perfect. I'll bring my own toolbox just in case. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Mina! I'm so glad I caught you — the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's a mix of things — some folks need help with leaky faucets, a broken fence, and a few porch steps that are getting wobbly. We'll have tools and snacks ready!
